description: Fetch one shift by id, including its breaks and publish state. When I Work: GET /2/shifts/{id}.

include_repeating_shifts_to.description: Also expand the shift's repeating series up to this date. Date-time, e.g. 2026-10-05T08:00:00-05:00 (When I Work's own examples also use RFC 2822, e.g. "Mon, 05 Oct 2026 08:00:00 -0500").

name: wheniwork_get_shift
title: Get one shift
